vol.name: Jonah Hex and the Shadow of Death

title: Jonah Hex and the Shadow of Death #2
desc:
SUPERSTAR MICHAEL WALSH DIVES INTO THE DARK WORLD OF JONAH HEX!

In Ashecott, tales of Jonah Hex's gunslinging past are known by few and believed by even fewer—save for Charlie, a young stable hand who admires the once-mighty bounty hunter. No stories at all are known about the mysterious preacher who has ridden into town, nor any tales of the strange followers he's amassing by the minute, and least of all their connection to the young girl who's vanished into the night.

Hex, however, is about to join their story—and in doing so, add a final chapter to his legend.
